definition.description: Presence of hypothyroidism prior to the start of the current treatment line.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient has a diagnosis of hypothyroidism. This can be identified by an explicit diagnosis (e.g., 'hypothyroidism'), the use of thyroid hormone replacement therapy (e.g., levothyroxine), or laboratory results indicating hypothyroidism (e.g., elevated TSH).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Absent' if no mention of hypothyroidism, related medications, or relevant laboratory findings is found in the record.
definition.name: hypothyroidism_presence

definition.description: Patient's history of illicit drug use.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient has a documented history of using illicit drugs or illegal substances from the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the record does not specify or is ambiguous regarding illicit drug use.
definition.name: illicit_drug_use

definition.description: Whether a computed tomography (CT) scan was performed during the pretreatment period.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if there is any documentation in the patient record indicating that a CT scan (e.g., enhanced CT) was performed.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'No' if the record is searched and no CT scan is mentioned; represent as null if the patient record is entirely missing or unavailable.
definition.name: imaging_ct_scan_performed

definition.description: Qualitative assessment of FDG uptake in the cerebellar hemispheres from PET imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the reported level of FDG uptake in the cerebellum from the imaging report, identifying whether the uptake is normal, decreased (hypometabolism), or increased (hypermetabolism).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the cerebellar FDG uptake is not mentioned or the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: imaging_finding_cerebellar_fdg_uptake

definition.description: Presence of a mass in the right lower lobe of the lung as identified by imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the pretreatment imaging report (e.g., chest CT or X-ray) explicitly documents the presence of a mass located in the right lower lobe of the lung.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if imaging reports are unavailable or if the right lower lobe is not assessed/mentioned.
definition.name: imaging_finding_right_lower_lobe_mass

definition.description: Presence of a mass in the upper lobe of the lung on imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify from pretreatment imaging reports (e.g., CT, chest X-ray) if a mass is documented in the upper lobe of the lung.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if imaging reports are unavailable or if the report does not mention the upper lobe.
definition.name: imaging_finding_upper_lobe_mass

definition.description: Whether a magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scan was performed.
definition.measurement_definition: Determine if the pretreatment clinical record contains any evidence that a magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scan was performed for the patient.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'No' if there is no documentation of an MRI being performed.
definition.name: imaging_mri_performed

definition.description: Maximum Standardized Uptake Value (SUVmax) measured via PET imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the highest reported standardized uptake value (SUVmax) for the primary tumor or most metabolic lesion from the pretreatment PET scan.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no numeric SUVmax value is documented in the record.
definition.name: imaging_pet_suv_max

definition.description: The specific type or class of immunotherapy agent administered to the patient.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the mentioned type of immunotherapy from the pretreatment record, specifically looking for terms such as checkpoint blockade, PD-1 inhibitors, or PD-L1 inhibitors.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Not documented' if no immunotherapy type is mentioned.
definition.name: immunotherapy_type

definition.description: The number of puffs of inhaler medication administered per dose.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value representing the number of inhaler puffs per administration from the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no numeric dosage is documented.
definition.name: inhaler_usage_dosage

system:
You review pretreatment candidate measurements using modeling evidence
from one outer-training fold. First identify themes across candidates; then
reconcile their roles as confounder, effect_modifier, both, or neither.
All evidence is fallible. No individual family, p-value, or support frequency is
a hard selection gate. A credible complementary signal can justify retention
even when other methods shrink it away. Do not mistake correlated aliases or
proxies for multiple independent discoveries. Themes organize evidence; they
do not establish equivalence, merge measurements, or transfer a role to every
theme member. Preserve investigator-locked roles exactly.

Treatment prediction, outcome prognosis, and confounding are distinct. Discuss
whether a candidate could be a common cause rather than an instrument or only a
prognostic factor. Effect modification needs treatment-heterogeneity evidence;
outcome main-effect importance alone does not establish it. Univariable logistic
interactions are on the log-odds scale and unadjusted for other covariates.
Orthogonal linear models, candidate R-learners, and causal forests assess the
probability/outcome scale after elastic-net nuisance adjustment. Their targets
and biases differ. A model family is evidence, not an independent replication.

Use exposure and evaluability denominators. Missing or nonconverged fits are not
negative votes. Repeated samples and folds overlap; support fractions are not
causal probabilities or formal stability-selection error guarantees. Raw and BH
p-values do not correct the upstream adaptive discovery process. Permutation
importance can be diluted by correlated alternatives and does not prove a
causal role. Compare fold consistency, methods, subsets, and conflicting facts.
Definitions and theme names cannot establish a role without the supplied
empirical evidence. Never invent an oracle, data-generating process, or hidden
truth. Return the requested JSON and cite only supplied evidence IDs.
